finding: P263-C48 incorrectly groups pcaK and pcaF as benzoate-repressed.
corrected_interpretation: Benzoate represses pcaK, but not pcaF. Both genes require PcaR and are induced by beta-ketoadipate.
scope: New author-source verification, not independent review.
